create_Keypoints_from_tensor: create a Keypoints object from a torch tensor with shape (N, K, 3) containing x, y, and visibility
convert_keypoints_to_heatmap: convert keypoint annotations to a heatmap of one-hot labels for Mask R-CNN training
extract_keypoints_from_heatmaps: extract predicted keypoint locations and scores from heatmap logits using heatmaps_to_keypoints
concatenate_keypoints_list: concatenate a list of Keypoints objects into a single Keypoints object using Keypoints.cat
index_keypoints_by_slice: index or slice a Keypoints object by integer, slice, or boolean tensor to select instances
